observations: Visually read h = f L V² / (2 g D), numbered (6.1). V alone has exponent 2; the entire 2gD product is the denominator. All letters and factors match latex/readable.

All six definitions match: h head loss due to friction over length in metres; f dimensionless factor; g acceleration due to gravity in m/s²; V velocity in m/s; L length in metres; D diameter in metres.
The dimensionless (dimensionally homogeneous) wording is printed and is retained without engineering correction. The full page supplies the IS: 2951 reference below 6.2; it is not inside this crop.

Visually read 1/√f = −2 log [(k/(3.7D)) + 2.51/(Re√f)], numbered (6.2). Checked both square roots, negative sign, coefficient 2, 3.7, 2.51, plus sign, nested parentheses and outer square brackets. No log base is printed.

The enlarged formula image shows baseline Re in the displayed denominator, agreeing with current latex/readable. In the definition line the source instead visibly prints R with subscript e. The current symbols entry Re loses that definition-line subscript; preserve the source variation rather than silently regularizing the formula.

Definitions: f = Darcy's Friction Factor or Coefficient; R_e = Reynold's Number = (Velocity × diameter)/Viscosity; k = Average height of Roughness projections. No unit for k or type of viscosity is specified here; do not infer one. D inherits metres from 6.1.
The full page includes a standard Fluid Mechanics reference-book sentence and IS: 2951 for Darcy-Weisbach head loss; neither supplies a logarithm base.
